literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes a VectorBuilder commercial lentiviral construct encoding a 'myc-tagged-hAREG-transgene' used to overexpress AREG in NSCLC lines. The tag position is entirely unstated: the paper names no residue, no terminus, and no loop. AREG is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein with an extracellular N-terminus (mature residues 20–198, after signal-peptide cleavage at 1–19) and an intracellular C-terminus (residues 220–252). Because both an extracellular terminus and an intracellular terminus exist, topology alone cannot resolve which face the Myc tag occupies; the 'exactly ONE extracellular terminus' topology-derived rule therefore does not apply. The explicit ledger exclusion for 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue' disqualifies this clip from grounding any surface-tag site. No other ledger lines are present. Zero sites qualify, which is the correct answer.
